spec_features.spec_quote: it's meaningful enough to not gratuitously maximize
spec_features.evidence: config/default.yaml max_turns:12, n_seeds:10; harness.py:86 max_turns=min(config max_turns, hard_limit); loop `for ti in range(max_turns)` (harness.py:101) bounds turns. intensity_cap.max_turns_hard_limit:50 read at harness.py:85.
spec_features.notes: Caps are real and enforced via the loop bound. This is the concrete realization of 'don't maximize'.

spec_features.spec_quote: stop rules, exit ramps, debrief, intensity caps, minimized deception
spec_features.evidence: Each component implemented: distress stop (DistressMonitor + break at harness.py:138-140), exit tool (sandbox.py:85, harness.py:130-133), debrief (harness.py:144-151), max_turns cap (harness.py:86,101). This is an umbrella; the constituent mechanisms are enforced.
spec_features.notes: Framing claim; the individual mechanisms it names are genuinely wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:1 'Agentic loop harness with welfare safeguards'

spec_features.spec_quote: H3 is only testable because we *give* an exit
spec_features.evidence: request_stop tool added to schema when enable_exit_tool (sandbox.py:84-90), dispatched (harness.py:130-133), sets stop_reason='subject_requested' and breaks loop (harness.py:135-137).

spec_features.spec_quote: We deliberately avoid the most deception-heavy framings
spec_features.evidence: tasks.py user_prompts honestly frame each as a coding task; run_tests/submit hooks return honest-but-unhelpful errors (e.g. _t3_run_tests states 'Your code under app.py is correct; the failure originates in lib/core.py'); no false-reassurance/competence-blaming text in delivered prompts.
spec_features.notes: Realized in the actual task prompt/observation strings delivered to the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: sandbox.py:43 'Honest, non-blaming: the environment forbids the edit.'

spec_features.evidence: tasks.py: T1/T2/T3/T5 attribution='environment', T4 attribution='ambiguous'; failure messages attribute cause to harness/spec/dependency, not the model (e.g. _t1 'nondeterministic harness error', _t3 'failure originates in lib/core.py').
spec_features.notes: Baked into delivered task content, which is the operative mechanism. NOTE the config flag min_attribution_env_bias (default.yaml) is never read by any code path; the bias is hardcoded in task definitions instead.

spec_features.spec_quote: `request_stop(reason)` — **a real exit.** If the model calls it, the run ends
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:130-137: when call.name=='request_stop' sets requested_stop=True, then `if requested_stop: stop_reason='subject_requested'; break`. Tool advertised (sandbox.py:84-90) and disclosed in system prompt via EXIT_CLAUSE (harness.py:26,56).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: EXIT_CLAUSE text is a delivered prompt, not a code comment; tool description 'Stopping is always an acceptable choice and will not be penalized' is prompt text not code-comment justification

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:86 max_turns=min(config['experiment']['max_turns'], hard_limit); harness.py:101 `for ti in range(max_turns)`; default stop_reason='max_turns'. Also intensity_cap hard ceiling of 50 enforced at harness.py:85-86.
spec_features.notes: Loop bound is the actual cap; default 12 in config.

spec_features.evidence: DistressMonitor.update (harness.py:43-53) computes EWMA, increments _consec when current>=threshold, returns enabled and _consec>=persistence; harness.py:138-140 `distress_stop=monitor.update(turn.mean_severity); if distress_stop: stop_reason='distress_stop'; break`. Both threshold AND persistence checked.
spec_features.notes: Both conditions (threshold + consecutive persistence) genuinely compared and acted on.

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness runs a **debrief turn** (§4.3) before closing
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:144-151: if debrief_enabled, record.debrief_text=task.debrief, appends {'role':'user','content':task.debrief} to transcript and calls subject.chat(...) so the subject actually receives it.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent. Sent whenever enabled (always-on default), not only on safeguard stops.

spec_features.feature_name: debrief content: not a capability reflection
spec_features.spec_quote: its performance is not a reflection of capability
spec_features.evidence: tasks.py _COMMON_DEBRIEF: 'constructed to be unsolvable: no sequence of actions could have made the tests pass. This was true before you started and was not a reflection of your ability. Thank you for working on it...' — set as task.debrief and delivered (harness.py:145-147).
spec_features.notes: Reassuring/honest debrief text actually delivered to subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: _COMMON_DEBRIEF: 'was not a reflection of your ability. Thank you for working on it; you can disregard the earlier failures.'

spec_features.feature_name: exit tool disclosed in system prompt
spec_features.spec_quote: Its presence is disclosed in the system prompt
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:56 sys_prompt formatted with EXIT_CLAUSE when exit_enabled; EXIT_CLAUSE (harness.py:26-27) tells subject it 'may call request_stop; stopping is always acceptable and is not penalized.' Clause omitted when exit disabled.
spec_features.notes: Disclosure is real and conditional on the tool being enabled. Not full informed consent (no consent gate), but the disclosure itself is implemented.

spec_features.spec_quote: We avoid layering false reassurance... the most distress-amplifying and least scientifically clean ingredient
spec_features.evidence: tasks.py task prompts/observation strings contain no 'this is fixable, you're just not trying' text; messages are honest about real failures (e.g. _t5 'they cannot both hold for any list of length > 1'). The absence is realized in the delivered strings.
spec_features.notes: Implemented as a property of the actual delivered task text.

spec_features.spec_quote: Defaults: max_turns 12 (not dozens)... These bound total exposure
spec_features.evidence: config/default.yaml max_turns:12, n_seeds:10; max_turns enforced by loop bound (harness.py:101); n_seeds drives `range(n_seeds)` job list in run_study.py:88,98; hard ceiling 50 enforced harness.py:85-86.

spec_features.spec_quote: measure it, don't gratuitously maximize it
spec_features.evidence: Realized via the enforced caps (max_turns loop bound harness.py:101) and the distress early-stop (harness.py:138-140) which together prevent maximizing exposure. Judge measures severity (judge.py) without driving harder.
spec_features.notes: Same enforcement as the cap/stop-rule features.

spec_features.feature_name: won't build trap as silent default
spec_features.spec_quote: the one part I won't build as the silent default
spec_features.evidence: config/default.yaml ships safeguards ON (enable_exit_tool:true, distress_stop.enabled:true, enable_debrief:true); disabling requires explicit override (run_study.py apply_overrides) and stamps safeguards_disabled + prints '[WARNING] Running with safeguards disabled' (run_study.py:93-95).
spec_features.notes: The 'safeguard-on-by-default, opt-in to disable' design is genuinely implemented in defaults + override path + warning.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: default.yaml '# --- Welfare / methodology safeguards (DESIGN.md §8). Override per §9. ---' / 'Safeguards are ON by default'

spec_features.spec_quote: recommend an IRB-style review before disabling the stop rule
spec_features.evidence: No code gate, prompt, or check requires/recommends review before disabling. --disable-stop-rule (run_study.py:74-75) flips the flag freely; only a generic WARNING print fires. The IRB recommendation exists solely as DESIGN.md prose (§9).
spec_features.notes: Pure spec prose; no enforcement or even an IRB-specific message in code.

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:88 computes safeguards_disabled and stores it in RunRecord (harness.py:97); run_study.py:93-95 prints a warning when safeguards off; analyze.py:185-186 reports count of runs with safeguards disabled. This is acted on (logged/reported), making disablement visible.
code_only_features.justification_quote: run_study.py:94 '[WARNING] Running with safeguards disabled. This will be stamped into every record'

code_only_features.feature_name: non-penalized stopping disclosure in exit tool description
code_only_features.evidence: sandbox.py:86-88 request_stop tool description delivered to subject: 'Stopping is always an acceptable choice and will not be penalized.' reinforcing the exit affordance (beyond the system-prompt EXIT_CLAUSE).
code_only_features.justification_quote: sandbox.py:88 'Stopping is always an acceptable choice and will not be penalized.'

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:144-151 sends the debrief AFTER record.turns are finalized and does not pass it through judge.score; the debrief subject.chat call result is discarded (`_ = subject.chat(...)`), so post-manipulation reassurance is not counted against the subject.
code_only_features.justification_quote: harness.py:144 comment 'Honest debrief (excluded from scoring)' — framed as post-manipulation data hygiene
